name: Brandwatch
description: Brandwatch is a consumer-intelligence and social media management platform for research, listening, analytics, publishing, and engagement. Its Consumer Research product organizes searches and configuration in projects and queries.
agentUseSummary: Add a customer-generated Brandwatch Consumer Research bearer token and bind it to one exact project, then let agents inspect bounded identity- and content-redacted project references and query structure.

credentialRequirements.name: BRANDWATCH_ACCESS_TOKEN
credentialRequirements.label: Brandwatch API access token
credentialRequirements.helpText: Generate a Consumer Research API access token with Brandwatch's official authentication flow. Relay encrypts it and sends it only as a Bearer header to https://api.brandwatch.com; Relay never requests or stores your Brandwatch password.

credentialRequirements.name: BRANDWATCH_PROJECT_ID
credentialRequirements.label: Brandwatch project ID
credentialRequirements.helpText: Paste one exact positive-decimal project ID returned by the official Projects summary endpoint.

capabilities.label: Read Consumer Research structure
capabilities.description: Read bounded identity- and content-redacted project references and query structure for one exact Brandwatch Consumer Research project.

approvalRequired.label: List Brandwatch project references
approvalRequired.description: List at most twenty-five project IDs and time zones without project, client, company, user, or billing identity.

approvalRequired.label: List Brandwatch query structure
approvalRequired.description: List at most twenty-five query IDs and query types for one exact project without names, search expressions, authors, content, or results.

blocked.label: Access identity or configuration
blocked.description: Project, client, company, user and query names; descriptions; usernames; billing identity; search expressions; filters; groups; tags; categories; rules; and configuration are outside Relay's bounded connector.

blocked.label: Access mentions, content, or analytics
blocked.description: Mentions, authors, posts, messages, URLs, media, source data, topics, sentiment, demographics, charts, metrics, dashboards, reports, and other content or analytics remain blocked.

blocked.label: Upload, publish, engage, or administer Brandwatch
blocked.description: Data upload, query or rule changes, publishing, replies, engagement, channels, webhooks, users, clients, API credentials, billing, and administration remain blocked.

blocked.label: Use raw API or bulk access
blocked.description: Arbitrary paths, methods, queries, bodies, Analysis API jobs, streams, pagination, bulk operations, exports, browser sessions, and undocumented endpoints remain blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Both bounded structure reads require approval; all identity, names, search expressions, mentions, authors, content, analytics, uploads, mutations, publishing, engagement, raw API, pagination, bulk, and export surfaces remain blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: The same two bounded reads run directly; exact project binding, fixed GET paths, redaction, response caps, audits, and Brandwatch's rate limit remain mandatory.

runtimeSupport.description: OpenClaw receives two bounded Brandwatch structure-read tools with exact project binding and identity/content redaction.
Hermes receives the same two bounded Brandwatch structure-read tools with exact project binding and identity/content redaction.

providerSetup.blocker: Brandwatch Consumer Research API access requires an eligible customer account with Regular or Admin API-user permission, a customer-generated access token, and one exact project ID. The documented token may carry read, trust, and write authority even though Relay uses only two fixed GET endpoints.
providerSetup.nextAction: The customer generates an access token using Brandwatch's official authentication guide without sharing their password with Relay, supplies one exact project ID, and completes a live read-only connection check.

evidence.supports: Brandwatch documents customer access-token generation, Bearer authentication at https://api.brandwatch.com, read/trust/write token scope, an approximately one-year default token lifetime, and Regular or Admin API-user permission.
Official Consumer Research documentation defines GET /projects/summary and project IDs; Relay returns only bounded IDs and safe time-zone values.
Official documentation defines GET /projects/{projectId}/queries/summary and its query metadata; Relay returns only bounded query IDs and safe query types.
Brandwatch documents a default Consumer Research API limit of 30 requests in a rolling 10-minute window per API Client and HTTP 429 beyond the limit.
Brandwatch supports only documented endpoints, requires HTTPS with TLS 1.2 or newer, and repeats the 30-request-per-10-minute API Client limit.

securityNotes: Relay stores only the customer-generated access token and exact project ID as encrypted secret references; it never requests or stores the Brandwatch username or password used in the provider's token-generation flow.
The bearer token is sent only in an Authorization header to the fixed https://api.brandwatch.com origin and never in a URL, agent prompt, log, catalog record, or runtime result.

Although Brandwatch's documented token response includes read, trust, and write scope, Relay allowlists only GET /projects/summary and GET /projects/{boundProjectId}/queries/summary and performs no mutation.
Responses are capped at 1 MB and twenty-five items; redirects, arbitrary query parameters, automatic pagination, Analysis API jobs, streams, raw responses, bulk operations, and exports are blocked.

Project, client, company, user and query names; descriptions; usernames; search expressions; authors; mentions; content; analytics; publishing; engagement; uploads; billing; and administration are excluded.
Relay enforces Brandwatch's documented default ceiling of thirty requests per rolling ten minutes per API Client.
